messages.subject: bar graph
parts:
I have the following data frame

Q1<-structure(list(answer = structure(c(5L, 2L, 3L, 1L, 4L), .Label = c("Agree", 
"Disagree", "Neutral", "Strongly Agree", "Strongly Disagree"), class = "factor"), 
    frecuency = c(1153, 1166, 1135, 1135, 1132)), .Names = c("answer", 
"frecuency"), row.names = c(NA, -5L), class = "data.frame")

I want plot a bar for each answer with height equal to "frecuency"

How can I do this with ggplot2?

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: bar graph

Answer to myself

If there is a better way, please let me know

Thanks!
